in_marathi.name: Chandravadan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandravadan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandravadan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Vadan' meaning gift or offering. This name is believed to be a gift from the moon god, signifying his blessings and protection.
